comment: Three figures in the maker's manual disagree with the code, and the code is what is written here. The manual says a knob at full scale equates to a sixth of the sampled S&H voltage; BinarySequencerPlus.cpp:372 divides by eighty against eight knobs of ±10, which is an eighth. The manual's prime row reads 1, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 15, 17; BinarySequencerPlus.cpp:76 holds 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19. The manual gives the B1 divisions as 2 to 256; BinarySequencerPlus.cpp:73 masks the counter with 1 to 128, one bit per knob. Because the numbers differ per mode and per flip state, the division knobs' own line names none of them; the knob's tooltip is renamed to the division it currently holds.
